headlines.text: Back on this day in 2026, the AEW Women's World Title found a new home as Thekla vs. Kris Statlander battled it out in a Strap Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.06 ? a real highlight of the night ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. Thekla dethroned Kris Statlander in a bloody Strap Match to win the AEW Women's World Championship, with interference from the Sisters of Sin proving decisive.
Looking back to 2022, when it was Roppongi Vice's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 7.45 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle.

On a Wednesday in 2026, back when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Kyle Fletcher vs. Tommaso Ciampa battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.08 ? a stone-cold classic ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. secondaries.text: That Wednesday in 2026, Myron Reed touched down in AEW for the first time, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.34 ? a solid showing. Myron Reed teamed with the Rascalz in a three-way tag team title contender's match against the Young Bucks and Private Party.
